title: Strategy Synthesis Response
description: Required structured-output shape for the strategy-synthesis LLM call (prompts/shared/strategy/strategy-synthesis.v1.md). The LLM synthesizes human-readable recommendations from supplied deterministic-observation.schema.json evidence -- it must not invent metrics, invent causation, or upgrade confidence beyond what evidence.sample_size permits. Every downstream insight is passed through create_strategy_insight()'s deterministic QC gate regardless of what this response contains -- see docs/architecture/analytics-strategy-pipeline.md#strategy-qc.

observation.description: What was observed, distinct from the recommendation -- must restate only supplied deterministic-observation data, never a new number.

recommendation.description: The bounded, actionable suggestion. Must never include deceptive/clickbait tactics.

sample_size.description: Must exactly match the sample_size of the cited deterministic-observation evidence -- never inflated.

evidence_rule_ids.description: deterministic_observation.rule_id values this insight is grounded in.

limitations.description: Explicit caveats, e.g. small sample size or single-video basis.
